F16G.fTerm:
BELTS, CABLES, OR ROPES, PREDOMINANTLY USED FOR DRIVING PURPOSES; CHAINS; FITTINGS PREDOMINANTLY USED THEREFOR

Subclass indexes

1/00, 5/00; 3/00, 7/00

9/00; 11/00

13/00, 15/00, 17/00

F16G1/00A.ja: 機能に特徴を有するもの

F16G1/00C.en: with the transmitting condition detection function, e.g. wearing detection, break detection color display and signal issuance sections

F16G1/00D.ja: 表面特性を改良したもの，例．防滑，潤滑，耐摩耗処理
F16G1/00D.en: Improved surface properties, e.g. slip prevention, lubrication and antifriction treatments

F16G1/00E.en: with the heat-proof or radiation function
